hero.title: AX/E 25
hero.heading: AX/E 25 – Electrifying 25ft Electric Powerboat
hero.subheading: Experience the Masterclass of Electric Boating
hero.intro:
The AX/E 25 is the epitome of innovation and elegance in electric boating. Merging silent cruising with impressive performance, this boat is designed for those who appreciate the finer things in life. Its iconic signature design and trailer-ready versatility make it ideal for exploring new waters with style and ease.

The AX/E 25 enhances this experience with a sleek exterior, spacious interior, and advanced technology, delivering both thrilling adventures and effortless comfort. Engineered for both adventure and practicality, the AX/E 25 offers exceptional handling, impressive speed, and unmatched comfort on every journey.

sections.title: Powerhouse Performance
sections.intro: Equipped with the formidable Evoy Storm motor, the AX/E 25 delivers nominal 300 HP nominal with a peak boost of 600 HP, propelling the boat to exhilarating speeds exceeding 50+ knots. The instant torque ensures rapid acceleration, making every throttle response immediate and thrilling.

sections.title: Exhilarating Speeds and Precision Handling
sections.intro: This boat is engineered for those who value both speed and precision. The advanced twin-stepped V-hull design provides exceptional stability and precise handling, both at slow at top speeds. Whether navigating tight corners or cruising through open waters, the AX/E 25 offers a smooth, responsive ride that feels effortless and controlled.

sections.title: Effortless Control, Unmatched Comfort
sections.intro: Redefining the experience on the water, the AX/E 25 brings together agility and comfort in perfect harmony. Its sleek, narrow hull design ensures precise maneuvering, while maintaining a smooth, stable ride in all conditions. At any speed, from leisurely cruising to full throttle, the boat holds a true heading with exceptional control—offering a predictable and composed driving experience, previously unseen in electric boats. This level of seamless drivability is a direct result of Axopar’s signature hull engineering. With effortless handling, the driver remains in complete control, able to enjoy the surroundings and the company on board without distraction.

sections.title: Whisper-Quiet Operation
sections.intro: Enjoy the serenity of near-silent operation as the electric propulsion system hums softly beneath the water. At high speeds, the boat remains smooth and quiet, enhancing the connection between the captain, the vessel, and the surrounding environment.

sections.title: Eco-Friendly Thrills
sections.intro: Experience the excitement of high-performance boating without the emissions. The powerful electric motor delivers all the thrills of a traditional engine while ensuring a zero-emission journey, making every adventure exhilarating.

sections.title: Looking into the Future of Electric Boating

items.name: Refined On-Board Ambiance
items.title: Refined On-Board Ambiance
items.text: Mediterranean-inspired, with luxury accents and materials. Soft-touch materials blend with rugged resilience, ensuring that every journey is as comfortable as it is stylish.

items.name: Comfortable Cuddy Cabin
items.title: Comfortable Cuddy Cabin
items.text: The cozy forward cuddy cabin is perfect for quick getaways or as a comfortable overnighter for two. Featuring a cushioned V-berth, freshwater sink, and sea toilet, it blends practicality with comfort. Natural light floods through an opening hatch, while built-in speakers set a relaxing atmosphere. Thoughtfully designed, this space has everything needed to unwind, day or night.

items.name: Intuitive Layout
items.title: Intuitive Layout
items.text: Every element of the deck is crafted for ease and safety. The asymmetric design allows for fluid movement across the boat, with wide side decks and well-placed grab rails enhancing access and security. The helm is thoughtfully positioned for ergonomic control, and the adjustable windshield ensures comfort and protection in any weather. Spacious seating areas invite relaxation and social interaction, making every journey as seamless as it is enjoyable.

items.caption: The Cross Bow configuration enhances versatility with its extended forward deck, providing space for sunbathing, socializing, or enjoying water sports. Its open, spacious feel makes it ideal for those seeking a combination of comfort, functionality, and sleek design.

Building on the versatility of the Cross Bow, the Cross Top adds robust, all-weather protection without sacrificing style. The addition of a sleek T-top ensures shade and shelter, making it perfect for longer trips or unpredictable conditions, while maintaining the open-air experience for relaxation and adventure.

sections.title: Multi-Storage-Compartment – Smart storage meets practical design.
sections.intro: The versatile Multi Storage Compartment combines practicality with comfort. It provides storage for watersports gear like wakeboards, kneeboards, and waterskis while converting into a 1.50-meter sunbathing area with ease. A repositionable backrest allows passengers to sit lengthwise or crosswise, offering flexible seating. This smart design maximizes space and enhances comfort, perfect for day-long adventures without sacrificing the boat’s sleek, modern aesthetic.

sections.title: Innovation at Your Command
sections.intro: The AX/E 25’s advanced technology suite redefines the boating experience, making every journey smarter, safer, and more enjoyable. Designed to put cutting-edge innovation at your fingertips, the system seamlessly integrates navigation, monitoring, and connectivity, ensuring you stay informed and in control, whether you’re at the helm or managing your boat remotely. With continuous over-the-air updates, the AX/E 25 evolves with each adventure, delivering a boating experience that’s as effortless as it is exhilarating.

items.name: Next4 Q Experience Multifunctional Display 10"
items.title: Next4 Q Experience Multifunctional Display 10"
items.text: The Q Experience Display brings a new level of simplicity and control to boating by integrating all essential boat functions into a single, intuitive interface. This high-resolution touchscreen provides real-time system monitoring, navigation assistance, and entertainment features in a user-friendly format. With built-in 4G connectivity, Bluetooth audio streaming, and seamless over-the-air updates, the Q Display keeps you connected, whether you're at sea or at the dock.

items.name: Smart Boating Screen
items.title: Smart Boating Screen
items.text: An integrated Smart Boating Screen offers comprehensive navigation, real-time weather updates, and detailed system monitoring. It keeps the captain informed and in control, delivering all necessary data in a clear and user-friendly format. convenience of a smartphone.

items.name: Smart Monitoring App
items.title: Smart Monitoring App
items.text: The Evoy App extends the boat's capabilities beyond the helm, allowing for remote management of GPS tracking, charging schedules, and trip logging. Whether docked or out on the water, this app ensures that the boat is always within reach and ready for the next adventure.

items.title: Real-Time Monitoring
items.text: Stay connected with real-time data on performance, range, and battery health, all accessible at your fingertips. This continuous flow of information helps ensure a smooth and well-informed boating experience.

items.title: Remote Access
items.text: Control and monitor the boat remotely via the Evoy App, providing the flexibility to prepare and manage your boat from anywhere, ensuring it’s always ready when you are.

items.title: Continuous Optimization
items.text: Over-the-air updates keep the boat’s systems at the cutting edge, continuously evolving and improving to deliver the best possible performance and user experience.

items.title: Adventure Further
items.text: Powered by dual 63 kWh Kreisel batteries, the AX/E 25 offers an impressive range of more than 60 nautical miles or up to 12 hours of operation at 5 knots. This extended range is ideal for explorers seeking reliability on longer journeys.

items.title: Superior Battery Technology
items.text: Kreisel’s advanced lithium-ion battery systems, featuring patented immersion cooling, ensure maximum safety and efficiency. The batteries meet the highest marine safety standards (IP67 and IP6K9K) and are enclosed in a puncture-resistant shell, ensuring durability and protection against even the toughest marine conditions.

items.title: Rapid Charging for Long Adventures
items.text:
With DC high-speed charging options, the AX/E 25 minimizes downtime, ensuring you can keep your adventures going without long waits. Charging from 10% to 80% capacity takes approximately 50-60 minutes using 120 kW to 150 kW chargers (Charger: DC 120, Time: 50-60 min for 80% DoD, Plug: 400VAC Trafo). For a full charge, the batteries reach 100% in 1 hour 20 minutes at 120 kW, or 1 hour 10 minutes at 150 kW (Charger: DC 150, Time: 1:10, Plug: 400VAC Trafo).

These rapid charging capabilities ensure you're always ready for the next leg of your journey, even on longer coastal expeditions.

items.title: Seamless and Convenient
items.text: Charging is effortless and flexible, whether from standard 230V marina outlets or high-speed DC charging stations. Recharge while enjoying the scenic views, knowing your AX/E 25 will be ready for its next adventure with minimal interruption.

sections.title: Electrifying Precision, Unmatched Power
sections.intro:
The AX/E 25 is the ultimate driver’s boat, engineered for those who demand both power and precision on the water. Powered by the advanced Evoy Storm motor, delivering over 300 HP with peak outputs reaching an impressive 600 HP, this boat redefines high-performance electric boating. With speeds exceeding 50+ knots, the AX/E 25 offers exhilarating acceleration and dynamic power that will turn heads at every marina.

Built with Axopar’s signature twin-stepped V-hull, this boat provides exceptional stability and razor-sharp handling, even in the most challenging conditions. The combination of instant torque and meticulous engineering ensures a smooth, agile, and responsive ride, making every maneuver feel effortless. Whether you’re navigating tight corners or cruising at high speeds, the AX/E 25 delivers the thrill of high-speed boating with the quiet confidence of an electric propulsion system that’s as powerful as it is sustainable.
